cohorts: Exactly the 18 physical league training maps, both learner seats, 36 recorded sampled episodes paired with 36 greedy controls; all four retired original-opponent training maps, both seats, 8 sampled episodes paired with historical greedy controls. Preserve every draw and 0-gradient unsupported decision. The original referee samples and CPU timings differ from the historical baseline. No new arena, 12/8 recent scores, independent formal maps or additional outcome labels are requested or used.
historical_coverage: Audit separately which of the earlier 16 original roots remain after excluding overlaps in physical terrain with either training cohort. On each, compare ordinary parent and newly trained candidate commands; count responsive original terminal evidence only when the recorded same-snapshot root choices match both differing full orders and the downstream continuation is aligned. Report exact covered/total, positive and negative returns, and unknown separately. These historical diagnostics have no effect on the step.
measure: For both training cohorts compute actual deployed projection on the historical pair of legal full orders at the logged prefix/guard/slot: A*(new sampled logp - old sampled logp), divided by the actual scheduled opportunities. Report forward binary KL(parent||candidate) per supported and per scheduled opportunity, quantized parameter delta, and the independently free decoded normal legal orders with counts by seat, along with all signed deltas and explicit zeros. Projections hold the old route and support fixed. Evidence counts student-driven changes because the nonstudent bytes are verified identical.
mechanism_gate: Both cohort return-weighted log probability changes must be finite and strictly positive. On each of the two training cohorts both physical seats must include a changed legal full order on at least one of its recorded supported pre-action histories, with source/physical readback verification. Failures and zero changes are retained. A passing mechanism only qualifies a candidate for later independent evidence. No test of strength in this protocol.
reference_step: Previous 510c continuous float update norm 0.1019579465; its actual change between quantized deployment models was 0.2534314246. The 0.10 target refers to the continuous update, not the quantized readback.
step: At the original quantized 8da4b465 Sapling actor compute full ascent gradients of the previously defined return-weighted binary choice likelihood for both cohorts, divided by 432/64 offered decisions. For g_L and g_M strictly positive L2 norms, v=g_L/||g_L||_2 + g_M/||g_M||_2; take exactly dtheta=0.10*v/||v||_2 using one ordinary parameter addition, no optimizer, no decay and no iteration or line search. Stop if v=0. All value/auxiliary heads and the partner package are frozen. Export dtheta through the existing quantizer. The production policy retains the same decoder, mixture, guards and package code.
